input_fields.name: native_file_identity
input_fields.description: Readable native file path/hash and expected document identity.

input_fields.name: target_session
input_fields.description: Unique maximized SpaceClaim session prepared to open one file.

result_fields.name: reopened_document_state
result_fields.description: Actual opened document identity, path/hash, and active session.

procedure: Verify file path/hash and target session before invoking open.
Open exactly one native file and wait for the active-document identity to settle.
Re-observe active path/hash and return reopened_document_state and reopen_status.
Do not measure, save, export, or compare geometry here.
rejection_rules: Reject unreadable/mismatched file, ambiguous session, existing unknown prompt, or multiple open targets.
Do not treat a window title alone as file identity.
Do not proceed when the actual document cannot be bound to the requested file.
